UI/UX & Visual Designer

I’m Francine, a self-taught UI/UX and visual designer based in Cebu, Philippines. I create web interfaces, publication layouts, and video edits, with a focus on clear hierarchy, thoughtful typography, and purposeful motion. My work spans school publications, personal projects, and commissions.

Welcome back, Frans.

Sign in with your portfolio’s Firebase admin account to edit and publish.

First time? Set up your admin account

Connect your Firebase project to keep your editable text and media links saved online.

  1. Create a Firebase Web app, enable Email/Password Authentication, and create your admin user. Copy the Web app configuration and the admin user’s UID into the portfolio-firebase-config block in this HTML.
  2. Create a Firestore database. Download the setup instructions and rules below. Replace YOUR_ADMIN_UID in the rules and publish them.
  3. Use public image or video links, including Google Drive files shared as Anyone with the link. For direct uploads, configure Firebase Storage and set storageEnabled to true. Firebase Storage requires the Blaze billing plan.
  4. Host the HTML on HTTPS or localhost, sign in, preview your changes, and save to the site.

Passwords and login sessions stay out of exported HTML and browser drafts. A new page load requires signing in again.

Changes stay in a browser draft until you save. Media uploads go to your Firebase media bucket.

No unsaved changes.
